test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e.** 'frequent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context provided before and after the blank suggests that discoveries of old caves have become a common occurrence, which aligns with the concept of happening **often or being frequent.**
 
• 'Disorderly' pertains to a lack of order or organization, which does not fit the context of the frequency or commonality of cave discoveries.
 
• 'Ghastly' relates to something that is shockingly frightful or dreadful, which is unrelated to the notion of the frequency of occurrences.
 
• 'Delusional' describes holding beliefs or impressions that are contradicted by reality or rational argument, which is not applicable to the context of discussing the occurrence rate of old cave discoveries.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**frequent**'.

**Complete Passage is:** When another old cave is discovered in the south of France, it is not (1) ***usually ***in news. Rather, it is an ordinary event. Such discoveries are so (2) ***frequent__ ***these days that hardly anybody pays heed to them. However, when the Lascaux cave complex was discovered in 1940, the world was (3). Painted directly on its walls were hundreds of scenes showing how people lived thousands of years ago. The scenes show people hunting animals, such as bison or wild cats. Other images (4) birds and, most noticeably, horses, which appear in more than 300 wall images, by far (5)________ all other animals.
